cut: In src/restates.rs, store each indexed window’s source path and original line directly and drop the retained per-file line vectors. Fold matching windows into runs in one pass, preserving the current overlap rules and first-source selection. Share the per-measure baseline update loop between adopt and ratchet, keeping adoption’s guard. In src/cli.rs and src/restates.rs, pass the paragraphs already parsed by Seen::place to the shared detector so where parses each document once.
answer: Made all four: Index maps each window to (path, line) with no per-file vectors; copies folds windows in one pass, joining a following window and skipping an overlapping one as before; adopt and ratchet both call Measure::ratchet; find takes the paragraphs, and where passes its own.
